div.div:
Blue: application/HTTPS traffic • Purple: bootstrap administrative DB traffic • Dashed green: identity and authorization
Security groups and NetworkPolicy control TCP reachability. IAM permits the database login; SQL grants limit operations.
The app signs a fresh IAM token when opening a connection. Token expiry does not end an already established session.
